card.name: Sweeping generalizations about most or all
card.fires_on: Words just before a sweeping claim about nearly all cases, such as 'most', 'all' or 'any', in general web prose. It fires on the word or gap where such a quantity is expected, like after 'problem with the house,' or 'will' in a general rule.

modes.label: Before percentage claims
modes.description: The gap or digit right before a near-total share like '99% of the time' or '99% of cases'.

modes.label: Verbs in general rules
modes.description: Helper words such as 'will', 'used' or 'is probably' in broad statements about how things generally work.
modes.example: There is no doubt that fifteen well-spent minutes cribbing from secondary literature<< will>> in general help a student ask smarter sounding

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning 'the vast majority' or 'everything', and away from unrelated words.
card.plain: It fires where a sentence is about to say that something holds for almost all cases or for everything.
